🔥 openscreen | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating polished product demos and walkthrough videos from screen recordings.
✨ Key Features: • Record specific windows or entire screen • Record microphone and system audio • Webcam overlay with various positioning and shape options • Auto or manual zooms with adjustable parameters • Customizable cursor effects and path smoothing
📖 Summary: OpenScreen is a free, open-source desktop application for recording and editing screen captures. It allows users to create polished product demos and walkthroughs with features like AI editing assistance, automatic captions, and customizable recording options.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ tabatha | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Improving the efficiency and user experience of managing multiple Chrome browser tabs.
✨ Key Features: • Live tab previews • Search open and recently closed tabs • Reopen recently closed tabs and windows • Unified view of tabs across all windows • Support for tab groups
📖 Summary: Tabatha is a Chrome extension that enhances tab management by providing live previews of all open tabs, enabling quick searching, and facilitating easy switching and reopening of closed tabs. It aims to replicate the familiar Alt+Tab functionality for web browser tabs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 client | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop application for developers to interact with and test various network protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) locally and efficiently.
✨ Key Features: • Support for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket protocols • Local-first architecture with SQLite database for offline functionality • Collections, environments, history, and scripting capabilities • Postman v2.1 import/export • Optional real-time cloud sync
📖 Summary: Tetiva is a desktop API client for HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket, built with Go and Vue. It offers a local-first, offline-capable experience with optional cloud sync, providing a fast and private alternative to existing tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ cluster-sentinel | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide comprehensive observability for Kubernetes clusters by monitoring, storing, and exposing cluster events, metrics, and alerts.
✨ Key Features: • Watches Kubernetes Events • Persists event history in SQLite • Maintains a bounded in-memory read cache • Exposes Prometheus metrics • Provides a read-only HTTP API
📖 Summary: Cluster Sentinel is a Rust-based observability toolkit for Kubernetes that monitors cluster events, persists them in SQLite, and provides metrics and an API. It includes Prometheus alerts, Grafana dashboards, and Helm deployment for comprehensive cluster event management and analysis.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Shelter-Humanizer | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Improving and cleaning text content using AI, with a focus on local LLM processing for privacy and offline use.
✨ Key Features: • AI-assisted text rewriting and style improvement • Local LLM support (Ollama, DeepSeek, Qwen) • Unicode cleanup and character checking • Text comparison and change tracking • Preservation of numbers, quotes, links, and selected terms
📖 Summary: Shelter Humanizer is a Windows-based AI-assisted text editor that enhances writing by removing clichés, improving phrasing, and cleaning up Unicode characters. It supports local LLM integration for offline processing and offers features for style analysis and comparison.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
